tasks.label: Start The Novice's Bridge server
args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5501 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($listener) { try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:5501/index.html' -TimeoutSec 3 -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop } catch { throw "Port 5501 is already in use but is not serving this app: $($_.Exception.Message)" }; if ($response.StatusCode -ne 200 -or $response.Content -notmatch 'Install app on this desktop') { throw 'Port 5501 is already in use by a server that is not serving this app.' }; Write-Output 'Serving HTTP on 127.0.0.1 port 5501'; exit 0 }; py -u -m http.server 5501 --bind 127.0.0.1
